products.name: Ascent® X Series  Ascent® X5 with Stainless Steel Container
products.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XRJUGB4]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}       Features  Ascent® X5, our top-of-the-line blender, is now available with a 48-ounce Stainless Steel Container. Combining an intuitive touch interface with a refined, timeless design, Ascent X5 elevates any kitchen. The non-reactive stainless steel container resists stains, odors, and corrosion, handling hot, cold, and acidic ingredients with ease. With an automatic Self-Cleaning Program and ten Blending Programs (Smoothies, Frozen Desserts, Soups, Frozen Cocktails, Dips & Spreads, Smoothie Bowls, Frappé, Nut Butters, Non-Dairy Milks, and Spice Grinding), Ascent X5 delivers precision and consistency in every blend.     10-Year Full Warranty  Blend your favorite drinks, snacks, and meals for years to come.  10 Blending Programs  For convenience and consistent results.  Self-Cleaning Program  The Self-Cleaning program is standard on all Ascent X Series models. Just add warm water and a drop of dish soap.  Digital Timer  Removes the guesswork with recipes you process manually, helping you achieve the perfect texture every time.  48-Ounce Stainless Steel Container  Durable, stain and odor resistant, non-reactive, and easy to clean.  Tamper Holder  Conveniently attaches to either side of the motor base and provides easy access to your tamper while blending.  Tamper Indicator  On-screen indicator lets you know when to use the tamper to keep thicker blends moving.  +15 Seconds Button  Extend a blending program time by 15 seconds, for when your blend needs a little longer to complete.  Recipe Book  Enjoy 30+ recipes developed by our in-house culinary team specifically for the Ascent X Series. products.name: 1 x 48-ounce Stainless Steel Container
products.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=F4M695T]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}       Features  The iconic 5200 has been a fan-favorite since its debut, and for good reason. The classic 64-ounce container quickly blends small to large batches of your favorite recipes, and the simple, tactile controls make it easy to dial in any texture.The added Stainless Steel Container is durable, stain and odor resistant, non-reactive, and easy to clean. It’s perfect for healthy blends like non-dairy milks, tough raw veggies, nuts, and seeds.     Self-Cleaning  With a drop of dish soap and warm water, your Vitamix® can clean itself in 30 to 60 seconds—no disassembly required.  Variable Speed Control + High Switch  Adjust the speed at any time during the blend to achieve a variety of textures, from silky smoothies to chunky salsa.  64-Ounce Classic Container  Get great results whether you’re making a single serving or a full container.  Power & Performance  Designed to pulverize the toughest ingredients, blend after blend.  Powerful Motor  Professional performance at home.  Stainless-Steel Blades  Laser-cut from hardened stainless steel that doesn’t dull over time and pulverizes ingredients for incredibly smooth textures.  BPA Free Container  The container and lid are made of BPA-free Eastman Tritan™.
